title: The Mallworld School of Chaos! I recreated my Mallworld experiences with A.I.
content: Images from Mallworld The Mall is the spawn in point. Once you go “Semi-Lucid” you can go where ever you want. Some times sneaking behind the sceenes and ending up in different places. One of those places might be the School! This is always the same. Red brick buildings, filled with students, throwing papers. Getting lost, trying to find where their class is. Usually there is an over due assignment or some test that you forgot to study for. This can occur even decades after you have in real life graduated, yet you find yourself facing the final exam. Old bosses might serve as teachers, handing out tests with questions you can’t read. Sometimes the frustration is enough to get you “Semi-Lucid” which is the state where you realise that you are probably dreaming, and that nothing matters. You might even stand up and shout this at the teacher or other classmates, throwing the papers around or turning over desks in rebellion. This never goes well. Have you ever had a lucid dream? see more-https://tomdenneyart.substack.com/p/mall-world-school-of-chaos?r=6a1tcs&utm\_campaign=post&utm\_medium=web&triedRedirect=true
